title: SB 401 (S.D. 2, H.D. 1, C.D. 1) (2025 Regular (33rd Legislature)) — Ban on sale/transfer of assault rifles, assault shotguns and .50 caliber firearms; expanded detachable-magazine ban
operative_text:
Sec 1 definitions (HRS 134-1): seven new definitions; amends 'assault pistol': By adding seven new definitions to be appropriately inserted and to read:
Sec 2 (HRS 134-4) bar on sale or transfer: No assault rifle, assault shotgun, or .50 caliber firearm shall be sold or transferred on or after January 1, 2026
Sec 3 (HRS 134-8) prohibited items and magazines: The manufacture, possession, sale, barter, trade, gift, transfer, or acquisition of any of the following shall be prohibited:
Sec 3 definition of assault rifle: "Assault rifle" means a semiautomatic rifle:
Sec 3 penalty: Any person violating subsection (a) or (b) shall be guilty of a class C felony
Sec 4 (HRS 134-15(b)) exemptions: This section shall not apply to any pistol or revolver duly registered
Sec 5 savings clause: This Act does not affect rights and duties that matured, penalties that were incurred
Sec 6 severability: Every provision in this Act and every application of each provision in this Act is severable from each other.
Sec 7 formatting note: Statutory material to be repealed is bracketed and stricken. New statutory material is underscored.
Sec 8 effective date: This Act shall take effect on January 1, 2026.
